stated_limitation: One caveat: the NWB electrodes table does not annotate which LFP channel sits in the pyramidal layer, so absolute phase values are relative to the data-driven reference channel and the phase convention above; only differences between units are layer-independent.

justification.dataset: Dandiset 000044 Achilles linear-maze CA1 is the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta entrainment.
justification.handling: Real NWB streamed via remfile, LFP read by channel slice, run bouts derived from speed, and units filtered to >=100 run-bout spikes with cell-type metadata, all correct.
justification.analysis: Mean resultant length, preferred phase, Rayleigh test, and a spike-preserving circular-shift null are the right circular-statistics toolkit and are applied correctly.
justification.correctness: Every reported number (median R, significant counts, pop mean R vs null) reproduces exactly from the committed CSV and is internally consistent with the figures.
justification.figures: Figures show the effect clearly with labeled axes, units, and sample sizes, and example units are selected by R rather than a flattering criterion.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to a genuinely strong result and the write-up names a specific, real limitation about layer-relative absolute phase.
